dependency_acceptance: Extend existing typed-reference owner shared by native validation and strict path query; preserve untyped historical readability.
contract: A bounded recovery must retain invariants of both its original success attempt and its linked rejection transition.
Additional rejection invariants cannot disappear when returning to the attempt start. Recovery may retain additional invariants.
Keep existing guard equality, failed-attempt endpoints, independently approved retry bound, and concrete-attempt acyclicity.
A rejected terminal with recovery none may retain additional invariants without fabricating a retry. Legacy untyped transitions remain readable.
expected_tests: Shared typed-reference owner rejects lost failure invariant.
Strict independently bound path query rejects the same loss.
Preserved extra rejection invariant permits bounded recovery.
Additional recovery invariants and transition reorder remain valid.
Native authored validation rejects lost rejection invariants before execution and accepts retained invariants.
